The '''Manda sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It shared borders with [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan]], [[Endocray sector/Legends|Endocray]], [[Yucrales sector/Legends|Yucrales]], and [[Onatos sector/Legends|Onatos]] in the Mid Rim, and [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />
